args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 began failing health checks immediately after its latest production deployment, with an elevated error rate of ~18% across all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Mitigation: rolled back all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production (deployments show v2.2.9 and v2.3.0 healthy, v2.3.1 unhealthy; v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy in staging). Rollback completed successfully and was verified — all regions now run v2.3.0. Next steps: investigate the v2.3.1 changes for the cause of the health check failures, validate the fix in staging (noting v2.3.1-rc also failed there), and obtain change-manager approval before any redeploy attempt.
args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0
